notes: Opt-in scoped request subscription with an Effect HTTP body decoder; owned Option result distinguishes absent from typed unavailable/incomplete errors. Plain snapshots and history retain no bodies. Use message.text; stock WebKit returns only nonempty native reported text and refuses empty or missing reports because Blob/File data may be omitted. Chromium empty fallback reports are also refused.

audit.scope: Public declarations and implementation inspected; capability comparison preserves the notes on waiting, errors and identity.

decision.quote: Optional browser features do work only when requested, within the owning context or operation.
